stories.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
stories.body: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
stories.body: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

stories.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
stories.body: Lev Schlosberg is found guilty of "discrediting" Russia's army - a verdict he condemns as punishment for his political position.

stories.title: French PM heckled over wildfire response as blazes continue across Europe
stories.body: The prime minister announced on Monday €12m worth of aid to French regions that had been worst affected by the fires.

stories.title: Mushroom murderer Erin Patterson is appealing - here's what you need to know
stories.body: The Australian, who notoriously poisoned her family members, is trying to overturn her conviction.

stories.title: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
stories.body: The US actress, who has died at the age of 36, starred in the TV shows Heroes and Nashville.

stories.title: US hiker dies after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna
stories.body: The 30-year-old was on the active volcano when a thunderstorm developed, local media report.

stories.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
stories.body: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

stories.title: Trump envoy hails 'very good' meeting with Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
stories.body: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

stories.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
stories.body: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

stories.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump's bid to overturn E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
stories.body: The US president has already paid the writer over $5m in damages in the assault and defamation case.

stories.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
stories.body: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

stories.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
stories.body: The leading opposition candidate calls allegations of a planned insurrection "total fabrications".

stories.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
stories.body: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

stories.title: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
stories.body: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.

stories.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
stories.body: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.

stories.title: Aussie rules footy players under investigation as police probe sexual assault claim
stories.body: The Sydney Swans confirmed an incident had occurred in the hours after the team's win on Sunday.

stories.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
stories.body: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

stories.title: 'Ghana was the crime scene': The country leading the demand for slavery reparations
stories.body: Ghana has become Africa's leading voice in telling the world that Western nations owe reparations

stories.title: Thailand has a gun problem - 10 million of them
stories.body: Recent shootings have highlighted the country's troubled relationship with guns, with laws doing little to curb the violence.

**4. Long-term trajectories:**

The contested signals, particularly around Middle Eastern diplomacy and climate responses, highlight the fragility of these advancements and the need for sustained, structural solutions.
